targets.rawSql: select count(distinct case when u.auth_account_external_id not in ('None', 'Not Applicable') then u.auth_account_external_id when u.user_name <> 'None' then u.user_name else u.user_id end) as "Users" from wh_auth_token_accumulating_fact f join wh_user_dimension u on u.key = f.user_key where $__timeFilter(f.auth_token_issued_time)
select count(*) as "Logins" from wh_auth_token_accumulating_fact f join wh_user_dimension u on u.key = f.user_key where $__timeFilter(f.auth_token_issued_time)

select round(coalesce(sum(extract(epoch from least(s.session_terminated_time, now()) - s.session_active_time)), 0) / 3600.0, 2) as "Hours" from wh_session_accumulating_fact s join wh_user_dimension u on u.key = s.user_key join wh_host_dimension h on h.key = s.host_key where s.session_active_time <> 'infinity' and $__timeFilter(s.session_active_time)

select count(*) as "Active" from wh_session_accumulating_fact s join wh_user_dimension u on u.key = s.user_key join wh_host_dimension h on h.key = s.host_key where s.session_active_time <> 'infinity' and s.session_terminated_time = 'infinity'

panels.title: Logins & active hours per user

targets.rawSql: select case when u.auth_account_external_id not in ('None', 'Not Applicable') then u.auth_account_external_id when u.user_name <> 'None' then u.user_name else u.user_id end as "User", u.auth_method_name as "Auth method", count(*) as "Logins", round(sum(extract(epoch from upper(f.auth_token_approximate_active_time_range) - lower(f.auth_token_approximate_active_time_range))) / 3600.0, 2) as "Active hours (approx)", max(f.auth_token_issued_time) as "Last login" from wh_auth_token_accumulating_fact f join wh_user_dimension u on u.key = f.user_key where $__timeFilter(f.auth_token_issued_time) group by 1, 2 order by "Last login" desc

panels.description: Active hours = time from login until the token was last used (Boundary records last use approximately).

targets.rawSql: select case when u.auth_account_external_id not in ('None', 'Not Applicable') then u.auth_account_external_id when u.user_name <> 'None' then u.user_name else u.user_id end as "User", h.target_name as "Target", count(*) as "Sessions", round(sum(extract(epoch from least(s.session_terminated_time, now()) - s.session_active_time)) / 3600.0, 2) as "Session hours", sum(coalesce(s.total_bytes_up, 0) + coalesce(s.total_bytes_down, 0)) as "Bytes" from wh_session_accumulating_fact s join wh_user_dimension u on u.key = s.user_key join wh_host_dimension h on h.key = s.host_key where s.session_active_time <> 'infinity' and $__timeFilter(s.session_active_time) group by 1, 2 order by "Session hours" desc

select date_trunc('hour', f.auth_token_issued_time) as "time", case when u.auth_account_external_id not in ('None', 'Not Applicable') then u.auth_account_external_id when u.user_name <> 'None' then u.user_name else u.user_id end as "user", count(*) as "logins" from wh_auth_token_accumulating_fact f join wh_user_dimension u on u.key = f.user_key where $__timeFilter(f.auth_token_issued_time) group by 1, 2 order by 1

select case when u.auth_account_external_id not in ('None', 'Not Applicable') then u.auth_account_external_id when u.user_name <> 'None' then u.user_name else u.user_id end as "User", h.target_name as "Target", s.session_active_time as "Started", round(extract(epoch from now() - s.session_active_time) / 60.0, 1) as "Minutes" from wh_session_accumulating_fact s join wh_user_dimension u on u.key = s.user_key join wh_host_dimension h on h.key = s.host_key where s.session_active_time <> 'infinity' and s.session_terminated_time = 'infinity' order by 3 desc

select f.auth_token_issued_time as "Login", case when u.auth_account_external_id not in ('None', 'Not Applicable') then u.auth_account_external_id when u.user_name <> 'None' then u.user_name else u.user_id end as "User", u.auth_method_name as "Auth method", f.auth_token_approximate_last_access_time as "Last activity", case when f.auth_token_deleted_time = 'infinity' then 'active' else 'ended' end as "Token" from wh_auth_token_accumulating_fact f join wh_user_dimension u on u.key = f.user_key where $__timeFilter(f.auth_token_issued_time) order by 1 desc limit 100
